name: @sloev/corvax
description: CORVAX: find any peer by its key and open a WebRTC DataChannel to it. Universal discovery and signalling, zero dependencies.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=neutral --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/corvax.min.js --banner:js="/*! CORVAX v${CORVAX_VERSION:-$npm_package_version} | MIT | github.com/sloev/corvax */" && esbuild src/node.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=neutral --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/corvax-node.min.js --banner:js="/*! CORVAX node v${CORVAX_VERSION:-$npm_package_version} (bring your own host: SPEC §11) | MIT */"
